hero.title: Scale models that make a design decision easy to see
hero.subtitle: We build precision architectural models for architects, developers and institutions in Delhi.

services.name: Residential Model
services.desc: Homes, apartments and townships built to scale, with landscaping and material accuracy.

services.name: Commercial Complex
services.desc: Office towers and business parks, showing massing, facades and site context.

services.name: Mixed-Use Project
services.desc: Retail and residential combined, presenting how the layers of a development connect.

services.name: Institutional Building
services.desc: Schools, campuses and civic buildings, detailed enough for approval presentations.

process.title: Brief & drawings
process.desc: Send us your AutoCAD or SketchUp files, or a detailed brief. We confirm scale, materials and timeline.

process.title: Digital layout
process.desc: We prepare cutting files and a material plan, and share a proof before anything is cut.

process.title: Laser cutting
process.desc: Precision CO2 laser cutting of every component, from structural shells to facade detail.

process.title: Assembly & finishing
process.desc: Hand assembly, painting and landscaping, checked against your original drawings.

process.title: Delivery
process.desc: Packed and delivered ready for presentation, with care instructions for transport.
